overall: MARGINAL overall: calm on the Coron side and in the south, windy in the west this morning, easing this afternoon
limiterDetail: The main limiter is wind in the west: Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 17–18 kt until about 9 AM, Nangalao and Ciron 15–17 kt until about 11 AM, Barangonan 15–16 kt, all down to 13–14 kt around noon and 10–12 kt by mid-afternoon. Linapacan is 12–13 kt until noon, and Alava and Binudac 10–12 kt most of the day. The Coron side, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan stay at 10 kt or less, and Tara, Decabobo and Turda at 5 kt or less during the day. Current is the second factor: the Tara and Turda pickup about 6–11 PM (1.0–1.3 kt) and the west overnight about 2–5 AM Sat. Rain is light by day, then evening showers in the west about 6–9 PM. 24h totals run 0.6–10.8 mm.

changed.title: ℹ️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: No material change to the supply outlook. The west-side wind arrived overnight as forecast: Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Nangalao and Ciron are at 17–18 kt now (gusts to 23) and Barangonan at 15 kt. It eases a little faster than expected, to 13–14 kt by noon and 10–12 kt by about 3–5 PM, but evening showers follow in the west (about 6–9 PM, up to 2.8 mm/h).

Today stays SLIGHTLY SOFT , Saturday 31 stays NEAR NORMAL and Sunday 1 stays NORMAL with a slight trim. Sunday itself now looks wetter (10.8 mm, was 6.9), which deepens the Monday 2 dip slightly. The grounds now read 8 GOOD / 3 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (was 5 / 11 / 0 at 2 PM yesterday, when the west was in its afternoon lull). The PAGASA feed could not be reached this morning; yesterday it had nothing for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Fri–Thu (guide only). No new tightening risk beyond the Monday–Tuesday dip. Lean on the Coron side, Panlaitan, Maglalambay, Galoc and Culion for today's and Saturday's landings.

bestWindow.headline: Now to about 5 PM on the Coron side, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan; the west from about 3–5 PM, before the showers
details: Now to 5 PM: Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan 0.0–0.6 kt with wind 5–10 kt and dry. The easiest spell is about 7–11 AM (Coron and Panlaitan 0.1–0.2 kt). Decabobo is good by day (0.2–0.6 kt, wind under 6 kt).
West, about 3–5 PM: Barangonan and Linapacan drop to 9–12 kt and Cabunlawan and Decabaitot to 11–12 kt, with currents 0.2–0.6 kt, before showers about 6–9 PM.

Keep small boats off Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Nangalao, Ciron and Barangonan until about noon (15–18 kt, gusts to 23), off Tara and Turda during the 6–11 PM pickup (1.0–1.3 kt), and off Decabaitot, Barangonan and Alava about 2–5 AM Sat (1.0–1.1 kt).
